# Class: `InptkClient`

Queues toolkit requests and delivers results to the analysis window.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-inptk-client.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_inptk_client.py#L112) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QObject`.

Owns the transport thread, connection test, pending requests, and local worker jobs. Supports asynchronous callbacks and blocking helpers used at save boundaries. Stopping invalidates pending work; shutdown also joins the worker thread.
